result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but one clear data/rendering defect stands out: a discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '-0%', which is a nonsensical value. A couple of minor contrast issues were also noted. Horizontal carousel clipping and bottom-of-viewport cutoff were treated as intended behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The badge on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' displays '-0%', a meaningless discount value that looks like a formatting/calculation bug (likely a zero or null discount rendered with a minus sign).
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is 0 or undefined, and ensure the formatter never outputs a negative sign for zero. Only render badges for valid positive discounts (e.g., '-20%').

issues.description: The search field placeholder ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a very light gray background, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast against the field background, or use a darker icon/label to reinforce the field's purpose.

issues.description: Inactive bottom navigation icons and labels (Search, Orders, Profile) are light gray on white, resulting in borderline contrast for small text.
issues.suggestion: Use a slightly darker gray (e.g., #6B7280 or darker) for inactive tab labels/icons to meet WCAG AA contrast while keeping the active tab visually distinct.

issues.description: Badge styles are inconsistent between cards: the first card uses a white pill with green '€0 delivery' text while the second uses a white pill with '-0%' text, and the heart/favorite button background differs (dark translucent circle vs. plain white icon), creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge and favorite-button treatments across all restaurant cards so the same component renders identically regardless of card content.
